Posted by Michael Collier 58 pm Alarm.com Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:ALRM) Ratings Coverage
Among 5 analysts covering Alarmcom ( NASDAQ:ALRM ), 4 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 80% are positive. Alarmcom had 7 analyst reports since June 25, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. Stifel Nicolaus maintained it with “Hold” rating and $45 target in Wednesday, August 8 report. Raymond James maintained Alarm.com Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:ALRM) rating on Thursday, November 8. Raymond James has “Strong Buy” rating and $58 target. Credit Suisse maintained Alarm.com Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:ALRM) on Wednesday, August 8 with “Outperform” rating. Imperial Capital downgraded the shares of ALRM in report on Thursday, August 23 to “In-Line” rating. The firm has “Outperform” rating given on Tuesday, November 13 by Imperial Capital. Bank of America maintained Alarm.com Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:ALRM) rating on Friday, September 14. Bank of America has “Buy” rating and $65 target. The stock of Alarm.com Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:ALRM) has “Buy” rating given on Monday, June 25 by Raymond James. Below is a list of Alarm.com Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:ALRM) latest ratings and price target changes.

The stock increased 2.18% or $0.97 during the last trading session, reaching $45.4. About 110,571 shares traded. Alarm.com Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:ALRM) has risen 32.48% since December 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 32.48% the S&P500.
Alarm.com Holdings, Inc. provides cloud software platform solutions for the smart homes and businesses in the United States and internationally. The company has market cap of $2.18 billion. The firm provides interactive security solutions to control and monitor their security systems, as well as connected security devices, including door locks, garage doors, and video cameras; and high definition video monitoring solutions, such as live streaming, smart clip capture, secure cloud storage, video alerts, continuous HD recording, and commercial video surveillance solutions. It has a 167.53 P/E ratio. It also offers intelligent automation and energy management solutions, including smart thermostat schedules, responsive savings, precision comfort, geo-services, demand response programs, and energy usage and environmental monitoring solutions.
